blocks.text: Before opening a chapter, ask yourself what you want to find in it. A question, even a provisional one, turns reading from passive scrolling into a search.
Select a sentence in this paragraph: the highlight menu will appear. Highlights stay tied to the exact spot in the text.
At the end of the chapter, mark it as done: the course progress updates on its own.

units.heading: From a hint to a diagram

blocks.text: Highlighted sentences are the raw material. The diagram is born when you connect them: cause and effect, before and after, general and particular.
The panel on the right accepts Mermaid code. Every chapter has its own diagram, saved together with the rest of your study.
A useful diagram can be read in ten seconds.
Review starts from the diagrams, not the text: if a diagram isn't enough to rebuild the chapter, that's where it needs more work.
Reread the diagram without looking at the text.
Go back to the text only where you get stuck.
